description: This file is a PHP web page for a password change interface, including HTML markup, embedded JavaScript for form validation and UI interactions, and PHP includes for header, footer, and user interface components.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines the user instance number based on the current session's login user.

methods.name: cancel_save
methods.description: Redirects the user to the 'at_a_glance.php' page, cancelling the password change process.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends an AJAX request to save the new password configuration and handles success or failure responses.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates password inputs and initiates the password change process by calling set_config.
